note: Combat actions (manual 7-3). Each costs 1 action unless stated. 'roll' says what the sheet rolls when the action is taken.

actions.name: Move
actions.desc: Move up to your SQR in squares (1 square = 1.5 m). Difficult terrain costs double. Moving into cover: set your cover.

actions.name: Attack
actions.desc: Roll your weapon's attack TN. On a hit roll damage + Offensive Bonus; the target subtracts armor.

actions.name: Use ability
actions.desc: Roll your Class TN to land one of your ready abilities.

actions.name: Reload / swap
actions.desc: Load a spare magazine into the weapon in hand (the old one is discarded), or swap to your other weapon: only the weapon in hand can attack.

actions.name: Interact
actions.desc: Open a door, use a console, grab or pass an item to an adjacent ally.

actions.name: Aim
actions.desc: Your next location attack can shift the hit-location roll by up to ±5.

actions.name: Escape / disengage
actions.desc: Step away from melee without provoking an opportunity attack.

actions.name: Overwatch
actions.desc: Hold a line: free shot at the first enemy that crosses it before your next turn.

actions.name: Use item
actions.desc: Use a consumable: a heal, a stim, an antidote, a grenade.

actions.name: First aid
actions.desc: Stabilise or patch up an adjacent ally (Medicine / First Aid, or a med-kit).

actions.name: Other
actions.desc: Anything else — the GM decides the roll and how many actions it takes.

reactions.name: Dodge (proactive defense)
reactions.desc: When attacked outside your turn: spend 1 action — this round's if you have one left, otherwise next round's — and roll Avoid / Reflexes.
